title: Version Bump
summary: Suggests the semver bump a set of changes needs and warns when the pick is too small, so breaking changes don't ship as minor or patch.
description: Release picker that reads changes (Conventional Commits or tagged), marks the bump they need, previews each option's version, warns when the pick is too small (or a needless major), and reads back "1.4.2 → 2.0.0", handling 0.x, pre-release tags and their ordering.
catches: A minor or patch for breaking changes, which ^ranges would install
A major with no breaking changes
0.x versions, where the minor slot carries breaking changes in npm ranges
Pre-release tags dropped on release and tags that sort backwards (beta < rc)
limits: Only as good as the change list: commits without type or ! markers are missed
Semver says 0.y.z may change anything; the 0.x handling follows npm caret behaviour
a11y: Bump options are a roving-tabindex radiogroup with arrow keys
Needed bump marked with text, not colour alone
Readback and warnings in polite live regions; invalid input uses role=alert

rules.note: Confirmed §11 pre-release precedence (1.0.0-alpha < … < 1.0.0-rc.1 < 1.0.0) and that 0.y.z is for initial development.

stops: Breaking change shipped as a minor
